newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stad Rotterdam sees higher 1997 profits.
newsitem.headline: Stad Rotterdam sees higher 1997 profits.

text.p: Insurance firm Stad Rotterdam Anno 1720 NV said on Tuesday it expected to record significantly higher net profits in 1997.
"Through the formation of the ASR Insurance group, the net profit of the firm will rise significantly," Stad Rotterdam said in a statement with its first quarter results.

Stad Rotterdam said in April it was in talks to buy the 45 percent of fellow insurer De Amersvoortse Verzekeringsgroep it did not already own and that it envisaged listing the merged company, to be called the ASR Insurance group, in June.
